title: How Can Recommender Systems Benefit from Large Language Models: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing literature that evaluates user-side fairness in LLM-based recommenders, such as analyzing unequal job recommendations based on inferred sensitive attributes from user names, and evaluating datasets/benchmarks like FaiRLLM or counterfactually fair prompting techniques.

Summarizing studies that measure item-side fairness, specifically evaluating whether LLMs disproportionately favor popular items or specific news providers in ranking functions, and reviewing mitigations like full-text modeling for long-tail items.
